title: Interpret the logarithm
text: What number $$\log_{1/@{b}}\left(\frac{1}{{@{b}}^{@{k}}}\right)$$ is the power that $$\frac{1}{@{b}}$$ is raised to to get $$\frac{1}{{@{b}}^{@{k}}}$$.

title: Find the relationship
text: Find a power k so that $$\left(\frac{1}{@{b}}\right)^k=\frac{1}{{@{b}}^{@{k}}}$$
